trust_decision.summary: A pyexpat sub-parser created by ExternalEntityParserCreate must keep its parent W_XMLParserType alive, because expat's child XML_Parser struct is owned by the parent's struct. This is decided in W_XMLParserType.ExternalEntityParserCreate, which sets parser.parent = self, and the protection is ALREADY PRESENT at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names pyexpat ExternalEntityParserCreate, and this is the only app-level implementation of that method in the tree.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the fix diff contains no pyexpat change, so there is no published scope to argue about

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The finalizer frees the C parser; an explicit close or reset path that freed the parent struct while a child exists would be a sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The parent/child ownership lives only in expat's C code and is not visible from the RPython wrapper. A maintainer adding an eager-free method could easily overlook it.

O9_family: memory safety (native): use-after-free of an expat parent parser struct owned across a GC lifetime boundary

O10_build.toolchain: PyPy translation toolchain (rpython) or untranslated py.test with a host Python 2.7/PyPy2

j.j_sites_touched: pypy/doc/conf.py, pypy/module/cpyext/include/patchlevel.h, pypy/module/sys/version.py, rpython/doc/conf.py (version strings only; no pyexpat source)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Store a strong reference to the parent on the child W_XMLParserType (already present at interp_pyexpat.py:849).
